newsitem.title: UK: Farm policy has to be reformed, EU's Legras says.
newsitem.headline: Farm policy has to be reformed, EU's Legras says.

text.p: The next round of world trade talks, the prospect of European Union (EU) enlargement and likely developments in world markets will lead to a review of EU Common Agricultural Policy, the EU's top farm sector official said on Wednesday.

These factors combined meant that the EU had to get further reform under way by 1999, Guy Legras the head of the European Commission's directorate general on agriculture, told the Agra Europe Outlook conference.
Legras said that the EU had to think about reform now, or find itself in a defensive position - "the worst possible position to be in" - in the next round of trade talks, expected
